dedupe_keys.name: electricity knowledge graph preparation and appliance training pipeline

description: The Jozef Stefan Institute publishes the preparation pipeline for its household Electricity Knowledge Graph. Python routines parse source studies, derive load profiles and consumption statistics, organize metadata, populate PostgreSQL and generate linked graph records. The documented workflow also trains and evaluates TensorFlow models for appliance on/off inference. Public GitHub source is free under BSD 3-Clause. Coverage follows the associated international collection of household studies, with configurable paths for each input. Prepared load and appliance profiles can calibrate residential demand simulations using model-energyplus. A caveat is that reproduction requires substantial external data and a configured database; some documented steps reset database contents. Upstream licensing, time conventions and household differences still need review. The source and documentation were inspected without executing database operations or training models.
